description: ICT Market Structure concepts covering fractal swing points, Break of Structure (BOS), Market Structure Shift (MSS), Displacement, Order Blocks, and Candle Range Theory.

topics.name: Market Structure (Trend & Sequence)

deterministic_criteria.bullish_sequence: Consecutive Higher Highs (HH) and defended Higher Lows (HL)
deterministic_criteria.bearish_sequence: Consecutive Lower Lows (LL) and defended Lower Highs (LH)

rules: In a bullish market, swing lows are defended by smart money while swing highs are liquidated.
In a bearish market, swing highs are defended by smart money while swing lows are liquidated.

topics.name: Fractal Swing Points (STH / ITH / LTH)

deterministic_criteria.swing_high: High[i] > High[i-1] AND High[i] > High[i-2] AND High[i] > High[i+1] AND High[i] > High[i+2]
deterministic_criteria.swing_low: Low[i] < Low[i-1] AND Low[i] < Low[i-2] AND Low[i] < Low[i+1] AND Low[i] < Low[i+2]

rules: A 5-candle fractal defines an institutional swing pivot.
Intermediate-Term High (ITH) forms when a swing high has lower swing highs on both its left and right.

topics.name: Break of Structure (BOS)

deterministic_criteria.confirmation: Candle body Close strictly beyond prior swing high (Bullish) or prior swing low (Bearish)

rules: BOS confirms continuation of the prevailing trend.
Must be confirmed by a full candle body close; wicks alone do not confirm a BOS.

topics.name: Market Structure Shift (MSS / CHoCH)

deterministic_criteria.prerequisite: Preceded by a confirmed Liquidity Sweep (BSL or SSL)
deterministic_criteria.bullish_mss: Candle Close > Intermediate Swing High with displacement
deterministic_criteria.bearish_mss: Candle Close < Intermediate Swing Low with displacement

rules: MSS signals smart money reversal after external liquidity has been raided.
Wick breaks do NOT count as MSS. A decisive candle body close with energetic displacement is mandatory.
Must leave behind an unmitigated 3-candle Fair Value Gap (FVG).

topics.name: Premium vs Discount & Equilibrium
rules: Never buy in Premium; never sell in Discount.
Institutional buys must originate from Discount (< 50% Equilibrium); institutional sells from Premium (> 50%).

topics.name: Bullish Order Block (+OB)

deterministic_criteria.formation: Last down-close (bearish) candle prior to violent upward displacement breaking structure (MSS)
deterministic_criteria.invalidation: Candle body close below Mean Threshold (50%)

rules: Bullish OB represents institutional accumulation footprint.
Mean threshold (50% midpoint of the OB candle) must be defended on retracement.

topics.name: Bearish Order Block (-OB)

deterministic_criteria.formation: Last up-close (bullish) candle prior to violent downward displacement breaking structure (MSS)
deterministic_criteria.invalidation: Candle body close above Mean Threshold (50%)

rules: Bearish OB represents institutional distribution footprint.
Mean threshold (50% midpoint of the OB candle) must be defended on retracement.

topics.name: Breaker Block (BB)

deterministic_criteria.formation: Failed Order Block that was responsible for sweeping liquidity prior to MSS

rules: A Bullish Breaker is the highest up-close candle prior to a swing low that swept liquidity and reversed into an MSS.
Provides high-probability retest entry when paired with an overlapping FVG (Unicorn Model).
